title: Benefit Period Limits and Coinsurance Day Bands — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
Under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage, benefit days are numbered within a Medicare benefit period, and the number of a day decides whether it carries coinsurance.

| Figure | Medicare Part A Without Supplemental Coverage | Medigap Plan A or B | Medigap Plan K | Medigap Plan L | Full-Coinsurance Medigap | QMB Medicaid Crossover |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Benefit-period break: consecutive days without inpatient hospital or SNF care that end a benefit period | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Benefit-period day limit: SNF days Part A covers per benefit period | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Full-coverage day limit: last benefit-period day number with no beneficiary coinsurance | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |

### The two bands

| Band | Benefit-period day numbers | Coinsurance |
|---|---|---|
| Benefit days 1 through 20 | 1 to 20 | None; Part A pays these days in full |
| Benefit days 21 through 100 | 21 to 100 | The daily coinsurance applies |

A benefit-period day number above 100 is not a Part A day.

*Hypothetical illustration:* in any tier, benefit-period day 20 is the last day paid in full, day 21 is the first coinsurance day, and day 100 is the last day Part A covers in that benefit period.
